steps.intent: Withdraw from the stalled pushing contact before changing orientation.
Tilt the fingers inward and downward with the palm behind the drawer contact.
Reapproach the bottom drawer contact at a slightly lower height.
Push the remaining drawer extension inward with the inclined fingers.
Withdraw outward and lift to expose the drawer for actual closure review.
